_source.how: docker run -d --network none <image> sleep, then docker exec of each command (LANG=C); the stanzas of NAMES are the candidates apt-meta.txt.gz keeps (highest version, backports last) of the pinned Packages indexes; they are the only repository (deb [trusted=yes] file:/repo ./, Filename ./x.deb) and dpkg's status (Status: install ok installed, Filename, Size and the hashes dropped); the old status entry of the name is removed first.
_source.not_recorded: long descriptions (Translation files); Description-md5; the order of the raw index of Ubuntu stanzas of apt-cache show varies per package
